verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh ships its own AI agents (Customer Screening, Ongoing Monitoring and Transaction Monitoring agents), so letting users connect external MCP servers to extend those agents is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows any way to register or connect an MCP server or other external tool source. The Starter Plan FAQ says agent configurations are standardized and cannot be customized. The llms.txt file and the OpenAPI schema are documentation for outside agents to consume, not a way to plug MCP servers into the product.
